notes.title: Dev Update | v0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello there! I am back from a long holiday break, and I've made several more feature and bugfix updates for your enjoyment! Thanks again to those who have playtested with me and found areas to improve. I am planning to release the game's full version in all its glory this year, so barring bugfix updates this might be the last pre-release push.

In this update, I added another new unlockable item related to the Swimming Pool stage! Go check it out!

I also made a few other updates:
[list]
[*] Updated longest it loses/win modes to end the round when one player's time reaches half of the total round time
[*] Added a cool progress bar for longest it loses/wins modes
[*] Tweaked AI difficulty levels
[*] Updated AI logic to mitigate clustering and constant swipe attempts
[*] Applied teams' colors on the victory/end screen icons
[*] Updated Marine's character sprites
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented starting a game after backing out of team selection
[*] Fixed a bug that kept held item sprites visible after items shut down at 10 seconds remaining
[*] Fixed a bug that activated AI stage selection when only Marine lost the round
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this update and look forward to the full release soon. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Dev Update | v0.7.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! There have been a few small feature/bugfix updates since my last announcement, and I want to thank everyone who has playtested and helped identify bugs and improvements.

In this most recent update, I added a new unlockable item related to the Swimming Pool stage!

I also fixed the following bugs that members of the Discord identified:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where all players could join the same team while holding the ready button
[*] Added ability to pause with the keyboard even if a player isn't using it
[*] Fixed a bug where AI stage selection would occur in an infinite loop
[*] Fixed a bug where the stage selection cursor wouldn't appear after quitting a 'random' stage selection game and starting a 'loser picks' stage selection game.
[/list]

There are more updates and content additions to come in the demo, and MANY more content additions in the full release. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Dev Update | v0.4.0, and Next Fest Thank You
notes.content:
Thanks for everyone's participation and feedback during Next Fest last week! Super Platform Tag gained about 110 wishlists during the event, so hopefully the word is starting to get out!

I just pushed a v0.4.0 update with some bug fixes and feedback implementation: 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where controllers wouldn't connect after a round or game had been played. 
[*] Fixed a bug where players could shove each other beyond stage boundaries.
[*] Fixed a bug where mind controlled players and mind controlling players couldn't access or navigate the pause menu.
[*] Added option to exit the pause menu using the start button.
[*] Made the control guide window 'pop up' at the start of the game to draw attention better. 
[*] Added a second button for both the jump and swipe controls.
[list]
[*] Note: I'm considering adding a player-specific option to toggle between two control schemes for players who prefer A/B for jump and X/Y for swipe. Let me know your thoughts on the controls!
[/list]
[*] Added item and game mode text descriptions in the Settings menu.
[list]
[*] Note: I'm planning to add more description text in the Game Rules menu too.   
[/list]
[*] Made some aesthetic, wording, and font style updates.
[/list]

For the next round of updates, I have several more feedback items to implement and I'll also focus on improving the stage art to show the walkable vs. non-walkable parts better.

Thanks again!
